name: Environmental Sci AP: Verdmere
subtitle: AP Environmental Science prep
shortDescription: AP Environmental Science practice that adapts to you: original questions, interactive labs, guided missions and timed mocks. Works offline. No account.
longDescription:
Environmental Sci AP: Verdmere is a practice companion for AP Environmental Science. It follows the 9 units of the course framework and turns every missed question into a clear next step.

### Learn Your Way
- Classical view in course-unit order, or Real-World view that starts from a real problem such as a polluted river, a power plan or a changing climate. Both views share your progress.
- Topic notes with worked examples, common traps and links to open sources
- Adaptive plan: a wrong answer points to the idea to revise, and the app tells you why that step is next. Pin topics, set an exam date and keep your own plan.

### Practise Like the Exam
- Original multiple-choice questions and free-response questions with a worked explanation after every answer and step-by-step solutions for calculations (860 multiple-choice questions and 24 free-response questions across all 9 units and 99 topics, every topic with at least 8 practice questions)
- Quizzes by unit, by skill or by your weak spots
- Timed mock exams in the style of the multiple-choice and free-response sections (8 in all), with a report and a study plan afterwards
- Constants, unit conversions and energy facts in one place

### Labs and Missions
- Interactive labs you can move and watch (10 lab benches: population growth, energy through trophic levels, food webs, the carbon budget, the greenhouse effect, watersheds, soil, air quality, power plants and demographic change)
- 14 guided Real-World missions that apply the science to a real task, such as a watershed, a power plan or a city air problem

### Made for Every Screen
- Text size from 50% to 300%, two-pane layouts on tablets, works offline, no account
- A Coverage screen that shows exactly what is included, and an Other boards map to GCSE, A Level and IB equivalents

### Honest Limits
The questions and solutions are original. All were checked by automatic tests, and 131 numeric answers were confirmed by two independent calculations. A separate read-through checked a sample of 407 of the 860 questions (47%) and found 23 faulty ones, which we fixed. The rest were not independently reviewed, so a few mistakes may remain.
